controls.description: An approximate 14.5 × 8.2 × 7.2 km triaxial fit from New Horizons images and photometry (Porter, Verbiscer and Canup, 2025). A contact-binary shape remains possible and the pole is uncertain. The standard gray grid marks unavailable mapped imagery; no terrain or albedo pattern is invented.
